160 degrees Fahrenheit is equal to 71.11 degrees Celsius.

$160$ degrees Fahrenheit is equal to approximately $71.11$ degrees Celsius.

Conversion Formula

To convert temperatures from Fahrenheit ($^{\circ}\text{F}$) to Celsius ($^{\circ}\text{C}$), you can use the following formula:

$$C = (F - 32) \times \frac{5}{9}$$

Step-by-step calculation:

  1. Subtract $32$ from the Fahrenheit temperature: $160 - 32 = 128$
  2. Multiply the result by $5$: $128 \times 5 = 640$
  3. Divide by $9$: $640 \div 9 \approx 71.11$
